pages.title: Kubanochoerus
pages.text: The Kubanochoerus ($(o)Kubanochoerus gigas$()) is an extinct giant pig that lived in Eurasia during the Miocene, millions of years before the ice ages.$(br2)It was one of the largest members of the pig family ever to have lived, with long legs and a large head.$(br2)Males bore a large bony horn on the forehead along with smaller horns above the eyes, which they may have used in contests with one another.
